title: JobPilot
description: A full-stack agentic AI application that parses resumes, fetches live listings from legal job APIs, and scores every job against the resume with embedding-based semantic matching and skill-gap analysis. A LangGraph agent layer with 8 nodes (search, matching, resume writing, cover letters, company research, interview coaching) works alongside a RAG pipeline over user documents using ChromaDB.
features: Embedding-based job-to-resume matching with skill-gap analysis
8-node LangGraph agent layer for the full application workflow
RAG pipeline over user documents with ChromaDB
Tailored resumes and cover letters exported as DOCX and PDF
JWT-authenticated FastAPI backend with a Streamlit UI
Kanban application tracker, Docker deployment, pytest test suite

caseStudy.problem: Job hunting is a grind of repetitive, error-prone work: reading dozens of listings, judging fit by gut feeling, rewriting the same resume and cover letter for every application, and losing track of where each one stands. Most of that effort is mechanical, which makes it a perfect target for an agentic AI system.
caseStudy.approach: JobPilot treats the whole application pipeline as an agent workflow. A resume parser builds a structured profile, live listings are fetched from legal job APIs, and every job is scored against the profile with embedding-based semantic matching plus a skill-gap analysis. An 8-node LangGraph agent then orchestrates the heavy lifting: search, matching, resume writing, cover letters, company research, and interview coaching, all grounded by a ChromaDB RAG pipeline over the user's own documents so generated content stays truthful to their real experience.
results: Tailored resumes and cover letters exported as DOCX and PDF per application
Relevance scoring with skill-gap analysis for every fetched listing
JWT-authenticated FastAPI backend with a Streamlit interface
Kanban tracker keeping every application's status in one place
Reproducible Docker deployment backed by a pytest test suite

title: AI Species Explorer
